children: Hong Kong financial services and consulting firm's H1 revenue fell to HK$7.6 mln from HK$9.5 mln
Company cites lower segment revenue in financial services and consulting businesses for decline
Group pursues expansion beyond Hong Kong, including the U.S. and Greater Bay Area, focused on cross-border mandates
SEGMENT REVENUE DECLINE - Co said lower revenue in financial services and corporate consulting businesses drove overall decline
DIGITAL BUSINESS DISPOSAL - Co disposed of Web 3.0 social platform investment early due to unsatisfactory performance and challenging industry conditions
